text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant denies allegation of Libyan pressure in refugee case.
- A Franciscan priest is ordained bishop. He will serve in Benghazi, Libya.
- Government considering amendments to Development Act to avoid Planning Authority delays in government projects, the prime minister says.
- Opposition attacks government over decision to change times of parliamentary sittings.
